d:
Watch exclusive making of the song Pani Da Rang featuring Ayushmann Khurrana and Yaami Gautam. The song has been composed by Rochak Kohli & Ayushmann Khurrana. Ayushmann also makes his debut as a singer with 'Pani Da'.
Film – Vicky Donor
Music – Abhishek-Akshay, Bann, Rochak Kohli & Ayushmann Khurrana
Actor – Ayushmann Khurrana, Yami Gautam, Annu Kapoor & Puja Gupta
Produced by – John Abraham,
Directed by - Shoojit Sircar
